name: databrain
description: Search a folder of your own documents, locally. Nothing is uploaded. Search returns file paths; text comes back only when you ask for one note.

brain_folder.title: Your documents folder
brain_folder.description: The folder you ran setup.sh in. Keep it directly in your home folder, not inside Documents, Desktop or Downloads: macOS gates those three and Claude cannot read them without extra permission. Everything stays on this computer either way.
